s: Din choleh beyom hakkippurim ubo y"ch seipim: choleh shehu omer tzarik ani leekol, ap al pi sheeno omer sheim lo yokal epshar sheyyistakken, ella leachar shehodiuhu shehayyom hu yom hakkippurim o sheyyodea meatzmo shehayyom hu yom hakkippurim veomer tenu li leekol, o sheomer eni yakol lisbol hattaanit mechamat choli, vekayyotze bilshonot ellu shennireh mehem kavvanato sheap al pi shehu yodea shehayyom hu yom hakkippurim ap al pi ken retzono leekol — maakilin oto miyyad, ad sheyyomar day, lepi sheen anu machaziqim oto lerasha, umin hassetam hu margish beatzmo shehu tzarik lekak, sheha"leb yodea marat napsho". Ulepikak apillu mea ropeim omerim sheeno tzarik leekol, vaapillu hem omerim shehammaakal mazziq lo — shomein lacholeh, shebbevadday hu tzarik lekak, kevan shehu yodea shehayyom yom hakkippurim veap al pi ken hu mebaqqesh leekol:

Vaapillu im hacholeh omer eni tzarik leekol veyesh sham rope apillu hu nokri veomer shehu tzarik leekol — maakilin oto al piv, vehu sheyyehe baqi. Veap al pi sheen harope omer sheim lo yokal yistakken, raq sheomer sheepshar sheyyakbid alayv cholyo — maakilin oto, lepi sheanu chosheshin shemma yakbid alayv cholyo veyistakken. Veap al pi shehacholeh beatzmo omer sheeno tzarik — en amirato nechshebet liklum kede shennachamir alayv bishbil amirato, deshemma mechamat terup haddaat hu omer ken, sheeno margish becholyo mechamat rob chulsha, usepeq nepashot lehaqel:

Rope echad omer shehu tzarik leekol verope echad omer sheeno tzarik leekol, im hacholeh eno omer kelum o sheomer eni yodea — maakilin oto, shessepeq nepashot lehaqel, abal im gam hacholeh omer eni tzarik — en maakilin oto, kevan sheyyesh rope echad sheomer kemoto — en anu tolim amirato beterup haddaat:

Im hacholeh en omer kelum o sheomer eni yodea, verope echad omer shehu tzarik leekol ushene ropeim omerim sheeno tzarik — en maakilin oto, lepi sheen debarayv shel echad bimqom shenayim. Veim haechad hu muplag bechokma neged shenayim haomerim sheeno tzarik — chosheshin lidbarayv lehaqel ulehaakilo, kevan shehu sepeq sakkanat nepashot:

Abal im shene ropeim omerim shehu tzarik leekol, apillu mea omerim sheeno tzarik, vaapillu im gam hacholeh omer sheeno tzarik — maakilin oto. Vaapillu im haomerim sheeno tzarik hem yoter mumchim vehen muplagim bechokma neged ellu hashshenayim — en holekin bispeq nepashot achar rob chokma velo achar rob minyan deot lehachamir, ella kevan sheshshenayim omerim shehu tzarik leekol vehen beqiim bechokma — hare hen chashubin kemo chakamim muplagim, kemo shemmatzinu leinyan edut sheshshenayim chashubim kemea miggezerat hakkatub:
Im harope hu ishsha o nokri — hare hu kekasher shebbeyisrael leinyan zeh, ben lehaqel ben lehachamir, veneeman lehakchish rope hakkasher shebbeyisrael, veal derek shennitbaer:

Im hacholeh omer sheeno tzarik veharope omer sheeno yodea im hu tzarik leekol, sheepshar sheen shum chashash vesapeq kelal sheyyakbid alayv cholyo mechamat meniat haakila — maakilin oto, lepi sheim haya harope omer sheyyadua lo sheyyesh chashash sapeq baddabar shemma yakbid alayv cholyo — hayu maakilim oto, laken gam akshav shehu mesuppaq bazeh — maakilin oto, shekkol sepeq nepashot holekin lehaqel apillu bekamma vekamma sepeqot:

Abal im harope omer sheeno tzarik vehacholeh eno yodea — en maakilin oto, lepi sheeno yodea shel choleh lav kelum hu, sherubban shel cholim enan yodein ubeqiin bacholi shellahen. Abal im hacholeh hu beatzmo gam ken rope baqi vehu makkir becholyo veomer eni yodea im tzarik leekol beyom hakkippurim — maakilin oto, lepi sheillu haya omer tzarik — hayu maakilin oto, laken gam akshav sheomer eni yodea — maakilin oto missapeq:

Veim harope omer sheeno makkir et cholyo — hare hu kishar kol adam, veen debarayv maalin kesheomer tzarik o sheomer eni yodea sheyyokal al piv. Veken kesheomer eno tzarik — en debarayv moridin kelal. Veim hacholeh (omer eni yodea o shehacholeh) omer eni tzarik verope echad omer tzarik — maakilin oto, veen mashgichin bedibre rope zeh sheomer eno tzarik, kevan sheeno makkir et hacholi:
Apillu bemaqom sheen sham ropeim beqiin sheyyaamduhu im hu tzarik leekol, mikkol maqom im nechelash harbeh ad shennireh lerob bene adam sheetzlo shehu mesukkan — maakilin oto:
Im hacholeh yodea beatzmo shetztzarik leekol umachamir al atzmo veeno okel — alayv hakkatub omer "veak et dimkem lenapshotekem edrosh vego'":
Kol maqom shemmuttar leekol veeno rotzeh leekol — maakilin oto beal korcho:

Keshemmaakilin et hacholeh sheeno omer tzarik ani leekol umaakilin oto al pi beqiim, veken keshemmaakilin et hamubberet shehericha maakal venishtannu paneha o kol adam shennishtannu panayv mereach hammaakal velo nityashsheba datam bitimat haroteb, veken keshemmaakilin et hayyoledet sheenah omeret tzerika ani leekol kegon tok shelosha yamim lelidtah — kol ellu maakilin otan meat meat kede shello yitztarep lekashshiur shennitbaer besiman try"b shechayyabim alayv karet umalqot, kede lehaqel mealehem meissur karet umalqot leissur bilbad, lekak maakilin oto battechilla pachot mikkekotebet dehaynu kishne shelishe betza benonit o meat yoter, raq shello yihyeh qarob likbetza shezzehu shiur kekotebet, veachar kak yishhu kede akilat arba betzim, ulepachot yishhu kede akilat shalosh betzim (ayyen siman try"b), veyachzeru veyaakiluhu keshiur akila rishona:

Vehashshetiyya — yibdequ bacholeh atzmo kamma hi, kede sheyyesalleqennu letzad echad veyeraeh kimlo lugmayv, veyashquhu pachot meoto shiur, veyishhu kede akilat arba betzim, ulepachot yishhu kede akilat shalosh betzim, ulekol happachot lo yipchatu millishhot kede shetiyyat rebiit (ayyen siman try"b), veyachzeru veyashquhu keshiur shetiyya rishona. Veim amaduhu haropeim o shear beqiin (kegon beyoledet sherob nashim beqiot betzorkehen veyesh lahen neemanut kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"l) sheen shiurim hallalu maspiqin lo, o shennistappequ baddabar — maakilin umashqin otan kol tzorkan miyyad kepi mah sheyyomru habbeqiin:

Abal im hamubberet o hayyoledet betok shiba yamim o hacholeh yodeim beatzmam shetztzerikim leekol — azay en medaqdeqim immahem bekol shiurim hallalu, ella notenim lipnehem maakal, veomerim lo yom kippur hu, veim atta yodea o shemmistappeq leka shemma yesh chashash sakkana im lo tokal kashshiur — ekol kashshiur, veim lav — ekol pachot pachot mikkashshiur, vehu yokal kepi mah sheyyeraeh beenayv:

Mi sheachazo bulmos, vehu choli habba mechamat reabon vesimano sheenayv kehot veeno yakol lirot — maakilin oto ad sheyyeoru enayv. Veim en sham maakal shel hetter — maakilin oto maakal shel issur. Veim yesh kan shene mine issurim echad chamur mechabero — maakilin oto haqqal techilla, shemma yaspiq lo zeh bilbad:
Im tzarik lebasar veyesh kan behema shetztzerikim leshachatah ubesar nebela mukenet — ayyen besiman shk"ch:

Choleh sheakal beyom hakkippurim venityashsheba dato beinyan sheyyakol lebarek birkat hammazon — tzarik lehazkir shel yom hakkippurim bebirkat hammazon, sheyyomar "yaaleh veyabo" be"boneh yerushalayim". Veim chal beshabbat — yomar gam ken "retzeh". Abal eno tzarik libtzoa al shette kikkarot, vegam eno tzarik leqaddesh al hayyayin velo al happat, mishshum shello tiqqenu chakamim debarim ellu beyom hakkippurim:
